name: Skittering Dark
summary: The Skittering Dark is an abandoned mine and shadowy woodland hollow in western Silverpine Forest. Infested by aggressive Skitterweb spiders and their massive matriarch, the cavern and its surrounding woods are littered with webbed cocoons containing unwary beasts and travelers.

sections.title: A Webbed Hollow
sections.body: Tucked between the Forsaken Rear Guard and the western coast of North Tide's Run, the Skittering Dark was once a working mine. Today, the shafts are completely choked with cobwebs, serving as the sprawling nest of the Skitterweb arachnids. Under the watch of a monstrous matriarch deep underground—and the shadowy weaver Krethis haunting the exterior—the spiders hunt anything that strays too close. Their silk-wrapped larder includes indigenous bears, worgs, and wandering worgen from the nearby woodlands.

faq.answer: It is an abandoned mine in western Silverpine Forest that has been entirely overrun by giant Skitterweb spiders. The cavern network and surrounding trees are thick with sticky webbing and predatory arachnids.

faq.q: What is inside the cocoons littering the area?
faq.answer: The Skitterwebs prey on local wildlife like bears and worgs, but their webs also trap feral worgen from the surrounding woods.

faq.q: Who leads the spiders in the mine?
faq.answer: The brood is led by the Skitterweb Matriarch, a massive spider nesting deep within the darkened tunnels of the mine shaft.

faq.q: Where is the Skittering Dark located?
faq.answer: It sits nestled against the hills in western Silverpine Forest, directly west of the Forsaken Rear Guard and just east of the shoreline known as North Tide's Run.

angles.text: Orcs venturing into Silverpine should take note: the Skitterwebs actively drag stranded Horde survivors from the nearby coastal shipwreck into their webbed dens.
